facts.summary: Halted lirentelimab and cut 50% of workforce to focus on AK006 · Phase 1 · lirentelimab (halted) in allergic/inflammatory diseases; AK006 in CSU · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The Company will halt lirentelimab-related activities across clinical, manufacturing, research and administrative functions. As a result, the Company will reduce its workforce by approximately 50%.
evidence.program_discontinued: The Company will halt lirentelimab-related activities across clinical, manufacturing, research and administrative functions.
